statement: \(ABCD\) is a quadrilateral with a circumcircle centre \(O\) and an inscribed circle centre \(I\). The diagonals intersect at \(S\). Show that if any two of \(O\), \(I\), \(S\) coincide, then \(ABCD\) must be a square.
Find all real-valued functions on the positive integers such that \(f(x + 1019) = f(x)\) for all \(x\), and \(f(xy) = f(x)f(y)\) for all \(x, y\).
For any positive integer \(n > 1\), let \(P(n)\) denote the largest prime divisor of \(n\). Prove that there exist infinitely many positive integers \(n\) for which \(P(n) < P(n+1) < P(n+2)\).
A regular tetrahedron has side length \(L\). What is the smallest \(x\) such that the tetrahedron can be passed through a loop of twine of length \(x\)?
Show that no \(n\)-th root of a rational number (for \(n\) a positive integer) can be a root of the polynomial \(x^5 - x^4 - 4x^3 + 4x^2 + 2\).

Let \(X\) be a set with \(n\) elements, and let \(F\) be a family of \(3\)-element subsets of \(X\) such that any two subsets in \(F\) have at most one element in common. Show that there is a subset of \(X\) with at least \(\sqrt{2n}\) members that contains no member of \(F\).
